answer: Split-tally bond stops fakes: each agent locks 70 credits, files a river tally from two gauges. A quill seal signs it; their delta is the claimed work. The seal is cut in half: work half in the river registry, receipt half with a delta auditor who replays both; rented-half ring reuse burns the bond. First tally 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
